description:
Morning Overthinking Reset 🌿 Bansuri Therapy to Ease a Busy Mind & Begin the Day Clear | Raag Bilawal | Episode 4 of Morning Reset

If your mind is already racing through the day before you are out of bed, you do not have to solve it all at once. Start with one slow breath.

This gentle Indian flute music is designed to ease morning overthinking: long, breath-led notes of bamboo flute that slow the mental chatter so you can begin the day clear.

Enjoy 1.5 hours of warm bansuri (Indian bamboo flute) over a steady tanpura drone, unhurried and without percussion or vocals.

🌿 MORNING RESET is our Bansuri Therapy series: calm-morning sessions at 6:30 IST. This is Episode 4.
Episode 1 — Morning Cortisol Reset → https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wINy9PW48iw
Episode 2 — Morning Stress Reset → https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ktm9KlNopoc
Episode 3 — Morning Anxiety Reset → https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2Ck0YsNm8bs

▶ Keep the calm going — the full Morning Energy playlist:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VIDEO_ID&list=PLeZN0byo199l9NGQ0ig-jCkqp0iwI3c7m
(paste this video's own id in place of VIDEO_ID before publishing — it opens the playlist at this video so the next one plays automatically)

Perfect for busy-minded mornings, meditation, breathwork, yoga, tea or coffee by the window, journaling, prayer, planning your day calmly, or a quiet commute.

🎵 ABOUT THIS MUSIC
Instrument: Bansuri (Indian bamboo flute) with tanpura drone
Raga: Bilawal (an open, natural-note morning raga)
Style: Indian classical instrumental, meditative
Mood: Clear, light, steady
Atmosphere: Early light, a slow breath, an uncluttered start
Duration: 1 hour 30 minutes

🎧 HOW TO USE
Press play before you check your phone. Sit or lie still for the first few minutes and let each long flute note set the pace of your breath, then keep it running softly as you start your morning.

⏱ CHAPTERS
0:00 A busy mind
9:00 First slow breath
18:00 Thoughts slowing
27:00 Space between
36:00 Steady breathing
45:00 Clearing
54:00 Lighter
1:03:00 One thing at a time
1:12:00 Clear and calm
1:21:00 Begin the day

⏱ BEST FOR
• Morning overthinking
• A racing mind at wake-up
• Meditation
• Breathwork and pranayama
• Morning yoga
• Journaling
• Planning the day calmly
• Tea or coffee by the window
• Calm commute
• Nervous system reset
